name: kryofix
description: PWA de gestion para servicio tecnico de equipos y smartphones (Firebase Hosting + Firestore).

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run audit:static && npm test
scripts.assets: npm run vendor && npm run qr
scripts.check:full: npm run check && npm run test:rules && npm run test:backend && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:backend: node tools/preparar-emuladores.mjs && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-kryofix --only firestore,auth,storage,functions "node --test tests/backend/*.test.mjs"
